submission:
Fix complete. In src/_pytest/compat.py, num_mock_patch_args() previously used `p.new in sentinels`, which invokes __eq__ on the patched value — for numpy arrays this yields an array of bools and raises "ValueError: The truth value of an array with more than one element is ambiguous" during collection. Replaced it with identity-based comparison: `any(p.new is sentinel for sentinel in sentinels)`, which is also semantically more correct for unittest.mock.DEFAULT sentinels.
